Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Vallejo for 2026, and here is what he found: 9 family events, 4 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (WinterFest at Six Flags Discovery Kingdom) through January 3, 2027 (WinterFest), with the Winter at Wonderland Tree Lighting and Ice Skating (December 4 and 5), the Mad Hatter Holiday Festival and Parade (December 5), the Teddy Bear Holiday Tea (December 6), How the Grinch Crashed Breakfast (December 12) and the Snow Many Toys Giveaway with Santa (December 18) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Vallejo

  • 9 Christmas events for kids in Vallejo
  • 4 free events, including the Winter at Wonderland Tree Lighting and Ice Skating, the Mad Hatter Holiday Festival and Parade, Mare Island Light Night and the Snow Many Toys Giveaway with Santa
  • Meet Santa: the Winter at Wonderland tree lighting (December 4), the Snow Many Toys Giveaway with Santa (December 18) and Breakfast with Santa at the Vallejo Community Center (December 19)
  • Parades, tree lightings and music: Mare Island Light Night (December 4), the Mad Hatter Parade, tree lighting and Lighted Boat Parade (December 5) and the VOENA Children's Choir concerts (December 6)
  • Skating and rides: free ice skating at Children's Wonderland Park (December 5) and WinterFest at Six Flags Discovery Kingdom (November 27 to January 3, 2027)
  • Season: November 27 to January 3, 2027
